title: Teotihuacan as a gold and silver ore processing plant using mercury

tellings.quote: >> and my hypothesis for the function of Teotwacon is that it is a gold and silver ore processing plant.
So thus pyramids of teotakon are lightning powered gold and silver processing facility.
tellings.difference: This telling says the plant was powered by lightning; the story talks about mercury instead.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Drumm's theory that Teotihuacan was a plant for processing gold and silver ore.

as_told.title: Teotihuacan as a lightning-powered gold and silver plant

plain: The pyramids of Teotihuacan, an ancient city in Mexico, were not temples but a plant for processing gold and silver ore. That is the idea of a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who calls it his own hypothesis and gives no source. The story's title links the plant to mercury, but in Drumm's own words on the show he says it was powered by lightning, which would mean the ancient builders had an industrial technology we have not recognised.
